maintained_cohort.stability_interpretation: Mojo server FD remains 10009 across all 1800 clipped snapshots; RSS rises by one 4096-byte page in the first quarter then stays 53567488 through quarters 2–4. This satisfies the original sampled FD/RSS stability criterion for the Mojo server. Go server FD remains 10007; RSS grows early then plateaus at 277929984 for the last two quarters. Loader RSS grows while retaining successful-latency samples and is reported separately. Original socket postflight passes for both roles with no replacements/early active closes. This is discrete sampled evidence, not a whole allocator/RSS cap, continuous maximum, exact kernel cause, new performance gate or proof that prior failed attempts succeeded.
maintained_cohort.context_limitation: Passive namespace snapshots are not cohort census or per-flow causality.
maintained_cohort.latency_rank_limitation: Source-proven planned-start scalar quantiles and sample counts; no exported raw ranks.
maintained_cohort.resource_scope: 100% CPU means one logical CPU; capture windows and positive clipped CPU intervals are discrete observations, not full-epoch CPU coverage, a continuous RSS maximum or a whole-allocator cap
